records.text: Owens speculated that Tyler Robinson could have disposed of clothes in cemetery dumpsters and then picked up lunch at Dairy Queen; she raised the possibility of a Tyler lookalike, maybe Lance Twiggs, without confirming it.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: and certainly could have played the role, as we were told at that time, of throwing out clothes in the cemetery. That could be how he participated in this day. ... How am I picturing that in my mind? Well, we have since learned, thanks to one of you tipsters at home, that the cemetery actually has two large dumpsters in the middle of it. ... So it could be the case that this is where he was dumping clothes. And then afterward, if he's involved in the morning with Operation Maroon Boys. ... that he was tasked with throwing out clothes, getting rid of evidence, somebody that was a Tyler Robinson lookalike, maybe it's Lance (Lance Twiggs), who knows, and it's possible that thereafter he just went to Dairy Queen to pick up lunch.
